rationale: C14 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template. Both letters transmit a commission report to Congress, characterize it as the product of intensive study aided by outside experts, summarize the problems and proposed actions identified by the report, direct Government agencies to conduct a detailed study, and promise later recommendations to Congress. The distinctive language and matching paragraph-level progression substantially exceed generic report-transmittal boilerplate. C09 has related report-transmittal language and the phrase concerning a “profound effect,” while C13 uses similar study-and-recommendation machinery, but neither matches the child as closely or comprehensively as C14.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The report, the end result of several years of intensive study and research by the Planning Commission and Council, aided by experts drawn from public agencies and private concerns
shared_material.parent_excerpt: This report, the fruit of months of intensive study by an independent citizen's group aided by experts drawn from Government, industry, and universities
shared_material.explanation: Distinctive parallel characterization of the report as the product of intensive study assisted by experts from governmental and private institutions.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The report also proposes a plan to meet the transportation problem and makes recommendations for organizing and financing the creation of the proposed transportation system.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: In more than seventy specific recommendations, the Commission points out the actions which, in its judgment, will best assure the mounting supplies of materials and energy
shared_material.explanation: Both summarize the report as identifying a major problem and recommending concrete actions to address it.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Accordingly, I am requesting the various Government agencies to make a detailed study of the Mass Transportation Survey report and the Planning Commission and Council's recommendations.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I am requesting the various Government agencies to make a detailed study of these recommendations
shared_material.explanation: Near-verbatim operative language directing multiple Government agencies to study the transmitted recommendations.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Such recommendations as are warranted will then be made to the Congress.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: As the need arises for legislation to solve materials problems affecting this Nation and other free nations, appropriate recommendations will be made to the Congress.
shared_material.explanation: Closely parallel closing mechanism promising subsequent recommendations to Congress after executive-agency review.
